Internal: consolidated notification for a multi-variable jdeclare_missing call

Source: R/recode.R
dot-jst_jdeclare_missing_bulk_notification.Rd

One summary block instead of one block per column: a bulk call on 52 variables must not print 52 near-identical notices. Variables are grouped by resulting branch (a single call CAN split branches – e.g. numeric codes applied under an active SPSS convention across a frame where some columns already carry Stata-form markers: the marked columns resolve to conversion while plain columns resolve to an SPSS-style declaration), each group gets one header plus one body block (the declaration is identical within a group by construction), and the durability note is returned apart from the blocks.

Returns list(block = , tail = ), as the single-variable builder does: tail is the durability reminder, NULL at the minimal tier and when no group changed anything.

Usage

.jst_jdeclare_missing_bulk_notification(
  data_name,
  target_vars,
  results,
  modify = FALSE,
  data_kind = "name",
  scaffold_var = paste(target_vars, collapse = ", ")
)

Arguments

scaffold_var

The text standing for the call's variables in the reminder's two lines (.jst_scaffold_vars(); S339).
